content.user_title: Create Platform Titles, Cover Text, and Video Openings
content.value_statement: Titles, cover text, and openings can attract the wrong audience when they promise more than the material delivers. This skill coordinates all three around a selected topic, supplied evidence, and the current filming stage.
actual_capabilities: Propose up to four audience-specific topics, with sample titles, required changes, and material gaps before the user selects a direction.
Draft grouped titles and captions for Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Douyin, and WeChat Channels, with character checks and brief reasons.
Write complementary cover text with line breaks, including a separate Douyin profile-cover version.
Draft openings for unfilmed videos, or recommend existing quotations, editing actions, and return points for recorded footage.
Limit suggestions to the requested title, cover text, or opening when the topic is already fixed.
Explore twelve editorial perspectives through three bounded subagent groups when deeper analysis is requested and subagent support exists.
limitations: Produces cover text only, not images, layouts, fonts, colors, or finished video edits.
Cannot guarantee views, engagement, sales, or independent verification of the author's claims.
Requires concrete source material; missing evidence must be supplied or left provisional.
Transcripts alone cannot establish audiovisual continuity or exact edit points without reliable timestamps and footage review.

use_cases.title: Prepare a short video before filming
use_cases.description: Select an audience and topic, then receive matching platform titles, cover text, an opening, and minimal script changes.

use_cases.title: Package an existing interview segment
use_cases.description: Use supplied quotations to recommend a cold opening, title, cover text, and a return point without requiring new recording.

use_cases.title: Coordinate copy across Chinese platforms
use_cases.description: Adapt one confirmed topic to platform fields while keeping claims, source details, and audience expectations consistent.

prompt_templates.title: Shorten one title
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this Xiaohongshu title within 20 characters, including punctuation. Keep the topic and facts unchanged. Return only title options: [title and supporting text].

prompt_templates.title: Choose a topic from a draft
prompt_templates.prompt: This video is not filmed, and I can revise the draft: [draft]. Suggest up to four audience-specific topics. Wait for my choice before drafting final copy.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: establish the audience and topic first.

prompt_templates.title: Create a coordinated publishing set
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this confirmed topic: [topic]. The video is not filmed. From [script and verified experience], create four-platform titles, cover text, and an opening with a transition.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare coordinated copy before filming.

prompt_templates.title: Explore and package recorded material
prompt_templates.prompt: Deeply explore audience directions for this recorded segment: [timestamped transcript]. No reshoots are possible. After I choose, recommend existing-quote openings, edit actions, return points, titles, and cover text.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: develop alternatives within fixed footage constraints.

output_examples.input: Rewrite only my English article title. The article describes three routines I personally use to prepare meetings.
output: Three Routines I Use Before Every Meeting
How I Prepare for Meetings: Three Personal Routines

output_examples.input: Use only these recorded lines: 'I stopped checking messages before lunch.' Later: 'I put the phone in a drawer.' No reshoots or timestamps.
output: Opening quotation: 'I stopped checking messages before lunch.'
Edit action: Move that existing sentence to the beginning.
Return point: Continue at 'I put the phone in a drawer.'
Original position: Remove the repeated opening sentence if it adds no new context.
Review needed: Check audio and visual continuity before joining the clips.

best_practices: Provide the original draft or transcript, target audience, platform, and whether filming or reshoots remain possible.
Confirm the topic before requesting coordinated titles, cover text, and an opening.
Supply real experience, figures, and source locations; review final wording and character counts before publishing.
anti_patterns: Requesting guaranteed traffic or invented achievements to make a title more persuasive.
Treating newly written dialogue as an existing quotation from recorded footage.
Expecting cover images, visual design, or finished video editing from a text-focused workflow.

faq.question: Which platforms does the skill cover by default?
faq.answer: Video tasks default to Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Douyin, and WeChat Channels. Other platforms can be requested explicitly.

faq.question: Does it generate cover images?
faq.answer: No. It generates cover text and line breaks, not images, composition, fonts, or color recommendations.

faq.question: Do I need to choose a topic every time?
faq.answer: No. A confirmed direction or a narrow wording request can skip topic selection. Unclear directions normally receive a short menu first.

faq.question: Can it work with footage that cannot be reshot?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends existing quotations and edit instructions while limiting promises to what the recorded material supports.

faq.question: Does it guarantee higher views or engagement?
faq.answer: No. It compares audience relevance and content support, but does not predict or guarantee platform performance.

faq.question: Does it require subagents or external commands?
faq.answer: No shell execution is required. The default workflow uses the main agent; optional deeper analysis uses three subagent groups when available.
